Plot cluster classification according to taxonomy

Source: R/cluster_fun.R
plot_cluster_classification.Rd

Clusters ASVs using different clustering parameters and classifies each cluster based on taxonomic consistency at selected taxonomic levels.

Usage

plot_cluster_classification(
  read_count,
  taxa,
  clustering_method = "swarm",
  cluster_params = c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10),
  vsearch_path = NULL,
  swarm_path = NULL,
  taxlevels = c("species", "genus"),
  outfile = "",
  plotfile = "",
  sep = ",",
  num_threads = 0,
  quiet = TRUE,
  log_file = NULL
)

Arguments

read_count

Data frame or CSV file containing the following columns: asv_id, asv, read_count.

taxa

Data frame or CSV file containing taxonomic assignments with one column per taxonomic level (e.g. domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species). Missing values should be represented as NA when no assignment is available.

clustering_method

Character string; clustering method to use: "swarm" or "vsearch".

cluster_params

Numeric vector of clustering parameters: Swarm d values or VSEARCH identity thresholds (values between 0 and 1).

vsearch_path

Optional path to the vsearch executable. If NULL (default), resolved via getOption("vtamR.vsearch_path") or the PATH (see get_path).

swarm_path

Optional path to the swarm executable. If NULL (default), resolved via getOption("vtamR.swarm_path") or the PATH (see get_path).

taxlevels

Character vector specifying taxonomic levels to classify and plot (e.g. "species", "genus").

outfile

Character string: name of the output CSV file containing columns: classification, number_of_clusters, taxlevel, clustering_parameter. If empty, no file is written.

plotfile

Character string: name of the output PNG file for the plot. If empty, no file is written.

sep

Field separator character used in input and output CSV files.

num_threads

Positive integer: number of CPUs to use. If 0, all available CPUs are used.

quiet

Logical: if TRUE, suppress informational messages and display only warnings or errors.

log_file

Character string specifying the path to the CSV log file. The path is resolved with the following priority:

  1. the log_file argument, if explicitly provided by the user;

  2. the vtamR.log_file option set with options(vtamR.log_file = ...), if set;

  3. "vtamR_log.csv" in the current working directory, used as a last resort if neither of the above is set.

To disable logging entirely, set log_file = NA.

Value

A connected scatterplot showing the number of clusters in each class (closed, open, hybrid) across clustering parameters and taxonomic levels.

Details

Clusters are classified as:

  • closed: all ASVs in the cluster belong to the same taxon, and that taxon is not present in any other cluster.

  • open: all ASVs in the cluster belong to the same taxon, but that taxon is found in multiple clusters.

  • hybrid: the cluster contains ASVs assigned to more than one taxon.

The function then plots the number of clusters in each class for each clustering parameter and taxonomic level.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot <- plot_cluster_classification(
  read_count,
  taxa,
  clustering_method = "swarm",
  cluster_params = c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10),
  taxlevels = c("species", "genus"),
  num_threads = 8
)
} # }
